title: FrameMentions
description: frame.mentions@1: what a composer's `@` menu shows. GET /api/frame/mentions?q=&site= answers this. People are Network accounts (public username, display name, canonical subject id and, only when the picture is an OpenVibe.Media one, its avatar); agents are the person's own rows from Network's agent directory; sites are the open OpenVibe places from the Frame; channels are Live's public channels. At most eight rows, people first, then the person's agents, then places; the site the box is on is not suggested back. Signed out answers public people only. A person row never carries an email, a numeric account id, a role or any other account field. `q` matches usernames, display names, agent names and place names. The read is rate-limited per actor (120 a minute in memory; HTTP 429 with Retry-After past it): signed in that is the person, signed out a hash of the address. A signed-out answer is public, max-age=60; a signed-in one is private, no-store.

id.description: A person's canonical usr_… subject, an agent's agt_… id, a site id, or a Live username.

label.description: What the menu shows: a display name, an agent's name, an OpenVibe site or a channel.

handle.description: The public @handle or site id, when the row has one.

sub.description: A short second line for an agent, e.g. actor · online.

avatar.description: A public OpenVibe.Media picture; never a Network-served, private or third-party URL.

url.description: The public page the row opens.
